context: From F9 (fork PRs #18, #20). Owner decisions needed in the adoption PR: (1) DataFusion Q11/Q20 now use generic decorrelate_subqueries; row results match official TPC-H answers at SF1 on DataFusion 52, but the plans differ from the hand-written queries so DataFusion timings for those two can move; if a published timing must not move, keep the replacements in BenchBox and use only the Q16/Q18 rewrites. (2) BigQuery 3_v9 NULLS LAST removal stays a caller-gated rewrite (strip_window_null_ordering) pending a live BigQuery check; making it generator behavior is a later decision. (3) DataFusion 52 answers all four original queries correctly, so the workarounds could be retired; BenchBox decides retire vs pin. (4) GROUP BY () drop now applies to every Spark/Databricks transpile (PySpark and DataFusion reject it). (5) BenchBox unit tests that assert NotImplementedError for ClickHouse COUNT/MIN/MAX and Presto window filters with COUNT(*)/DISTINCT must change: the fork now rewrites them. Stop for owner approval if the corpus diff touches published results.
